author: blu
body: The Identity effect is the right to read and act on the machine's identity. Once these two were declared here as effect operations with no handler anywhere in the tree, so a call type-checked clean and then died at emit -- CDX2034 for a nullary read that no handler had ever written. They are performable now: current-user and authenticate are real definitions over the identity builtins, so a chapter that holds the Identity capability can call them. The effect itself is now a bare marker, the way Network is -- the operations live below it as definitions, not as handler-dispatched operations.

author: blu
body: To current-user gives the Text label of the active identity -- the identity word this process carries, the same one SystemInfo reports -- or the empty string when there is none.
